purpose: Check whether a fixed original English source remains supported by each Spanish alternative; compare inverse-only selection with independent-score agreement.
source_target_roles: Each reverse-model request inputs a Spanish alternative and teacher-forces the original English source, prepared by the existing casing function. This is likelihood evaluation, not training. No correct Spanish reference or human verdict is input.
score: Mean original-source token log probability under pretrained OPUS es-en, including EOS and excluding padding. All alternatives for a source use identical English target tokens.
policy: Keep native unless a valid alternative strictly improves inverse likelihood. Agreement variant additionally requires strictly higher COMET-QE score. No margin search, source-word lookup, identity routing or output rewriting. Fixed pool order breaks ties.
selection: Among eligible policies: fewest confirmed failures, then most complete corrections, then fewest switches, then inverse_only to prefer the smaller runtime. Freeze choice before any control scoring; reject if neither qualifies.
